items.definition: Bir cümlenin anlamını koruyan yeniden ifadesini seçmeye dayanan sekiz soru.

questions.prompt: Unless the board reverses its decision, the university will lose its accreditation.
options: The university will lose its accreditation if the board does not reverse its decision.
The board will reverse its decision only if the university loses its accreditation.
Although the board reverses its decision, the university will still lose its accreditation.
The university lost its accreditation because the board reversed its decision.
Whether or not the board reverses its decision, accreditation will be kept.
questions.explanationTR: «Unless» = «if ... not»: kurul kararı geri almazsa üniversite akreditasyonu kaybeder: (A). (B) koşul ve sonucu yer değiştirir. (C) karşıtlık kurar ve geri alma durumunda bile kayıp der. (D) geçmiş zaman ve yanlış neden-sonuç kurar. (E) akreditasyonun korunacağını söyler.

questions.prompt: The company reduced its prices in order to attract more customers.
options: The company attracted more customers, so it reduced its prices.
The company lowered its prices so that it could attract more customers.
The company reduced its prices even though it had attracted more customers.
The company attracted more customers because it had reduced its expenses.
More customers reduced the prices of the company.
questions.explanationTR: «In order to» amaç bildirir: fiyatlar müşteri çekmek amacıyla düşürüldü: (B). (A) neden ve sonucu tersine çevirir. (C) amacı karşıtlığa çevirir. (D) nedeni giderlere çevirir. (E) özneyi müşterilere çevirir.

questions.prompt: Few of the applicants had the experience required for the position.
options: Most of the applicants had the experience required for the position.
Some of the applicants had more experience than the position required.
Most of the applicants lacked the experience required for the position.
None of the applicants lacked the experience required for the position.
All of the applicants had gained experience for the position.
questions.explanationTR: «Few of the applicants had» = başvuranların çoğunda deneyim yoktu: (C). (A) «çoğu deneyimliydi» der. (B) ve (E) deneyim fazlalığına kayar. (D) hiçbirinde eksik olmadığını söyler.

questions.prompt: It was not until the evening that the rescue team reached the village.
options: The rescue team reached the village before the evening.
The rescue team reached the village as soon as the evening began.
The rescue team had already left the village by the evening.
The rescue team did not reach the village until the evening.
The rescue team reached the village only after the evening.
questions.explanationTR: «It was not until the evening that ...» = akşama kadar ulaşamadı: (D). (A) ulaşmayı akşamdan öncesine çeker. (B) akşamın başında ulaştığını söyler. (C) köyden ayrıldığını söyler. (E) «akşamdan sonra» diyerek zamanı kaydırır.

questions.prompt: The professor was so tired that she could hardly keep her eyes open.
options: The professor was so exhausted that she barely managed to stay awake.
The professor was tired enough to keep her eyes wide open.
The professor was so tired that she fell asleep at once.
The professor was too rested to close her eyes for long.
The professor could hardly keep her eyes open because she was bored.
questions.explanationTR: «So tired that ... hardly keep her eyes open» = neredeyse gözlerini açık tutamayacak kadar yorgun: (A). (B) gözlerini rahatça açık tuttuğunu söyler. (C) hemen uyuduğunu söyler. (D) dinlenmiş olduğunu söyler. (E) nedeni yorgunluk yerine sıkıntıya çevirir.

questions.prompt: Although the flight was delayed, the passengers reached the meeting in time.
options: The passengers reached the meeting in time because the flight was delayed.
The flight was delayed, but the passengers still reached the meeting in time.
The flight was delayed because the passengers reached the meeting in time.
The passengers missed the meeting although the flight was on time.
The flight was on time, so the passengers reached the meeting in time.
questions.explanationTR: «Although» karşıtlık bildirir: rötara rağmen zamanında yetiştiler: (B). (A) rötarı yetişme nedeni yapar. (C) neden ve sonucu tersine çevirir. (D) toplantıyı kaçırdıklarını söyler. (E) uçuşun zamanında olduğunu söyler.

questions.prompt: She has been working on the project since January.
options: She finished working on the project at the start of January.
She will start working on the project at the start of January.
She worked on the project only during the month of January.
She stopped working on the project at some point in January.
She began the project in January and is still working on it.
questions.explanationTR: «Has been working ... since January» ocakta başlayan ve süren bir eylemdir: (E). (A) ocakta bittiğini söyler. (B) geleceğe çevirir. (C) yalnızca ocakta çalıştığını söyler. (D) ocakta bıraktığını söyler.

questions.prompt: The manager would rather the meeting were held on Monday.
options: The manager would prefer the meeting to be held on Monday.
The manager held the meeting on Monday because she preferred it.
The manager would prefer to hold a meeting every Monday.
The manager insists that the meeting was held on Monday.
The manager would prefer the meeting not to be held on Monday.
questions.explanationTR: «Would rather + özne + past» bir tercihi bildirir: toplantının Pazartesi yapılmasını tercih eder: (A). (B) tercihi geçmişteki bir olaya çevirir. (C) her Pazartesi toplantı tercih eder. (D) ısrar ve geçmiş bir olay bildirir. (E) tercihi olumsuz yapar.
